items.title: Gene muntaqil karne ke tareeqe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the methods of gene transfer (PDF 162-163).

blocks.text: Gene target cell mein us ki membrane ya wall ke raaste cell ko tabah kiye baghair muntaqil hota hai. Poora kaseer-ul-khaliya GMO banane ke liye gene gamete ya gamete banane wale tissue mein dala jata aur aise gametes mila kar GMOs banaye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe panel, har aik mein nucleus wala cell. Electroporation: barqi chingari aur membrane mein chhote soorakh. Microinjection: bareek sui nucleus tak. Biolistic: sunehre zarre cell mein daage gaye. Protoplast: cell wall dashed, yaani hata di gayi, aur medium mein DNA. Chemical: kimiyai maadde mein lipta DNA endocytosis se dakhil. Virus-mediated: virus gene pohanchata.
blocks.caption: Gene ko cell mein dalne ke chhe tareeqe (kitab ki fehrist ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Gene target cell mein membrane ya wall ke raaste cell ko tabah kiye baghair dala jata hai; poore kaseer-ul-khaliya GMO ke liye ise gamete ya gamete banane wale tissue mein dala jata hai. Electroporation mein barqi current soorakh banata hai jo DNA ko andar aane dete aur baad mein band ho jate hain. Microinjection mein bareek sui gene seedha nucleus mein dalti hai. Biolistic transformation mein bhaari dhaat ke nanhe zarron par chadha gene gene gun se mekanki taqat ke saath andar dhakela jata hai. Protoplast tareeqe mein cell wall hata kar protoplast ko DNA ke saath milaya jata hai. Kimiyai tareeqon mein nanga DNA kimiyai maadde se mil kar diffusion ya endocytosis se andar jata hai. Virus ke zariye muntaqili mein adenovirus, adeno-associated virus, HIV, lentivirus aur doosre retroviruses gene le jate hain.
